about.title: About Levan Margiani
about.p1: Levan Margiani (b. 1965) is a Georgian miniaturist and painter whose works often depict New Testament motifs.
about.p2: He employs church mural and icon painting techniques, usually working in tempera on levkas ground. Many works are presented in silver or tinted copper frames made by the artist.
about.p3: He graduated from the Tbilisi State Academy of Arts in 1998 and has held solo exhibitions internationally.
